name: Worship
overview: Scripture shows that worship is fundamentally about offering God what is truly valuable, as seen in Abel’s acceptable offering contrasted with Cain’s rejected one, emphasizing the heart’s intention (Genesis 4:4-5). Worship involves calling upon God’s name and building altars as acts of devotion and remembrance, exemplified by Abram’s response to God’s promise (Genesis 12:7-8). This engagement with God must be sincere and aligned with His revelation, reflecting a life that honors Him in all actions, acknowledging His supreme worth and seeking His favor rather than mere ritual acceptance.
